name: OTO – Shipping Gateway
author: otoglobal

sections.description:
OTO Shipping Gateway connects your WooCommerce store with the OTO logistics platform, enabling automated shipping and tracking for your customers.
Create shipments, print labels, and monitor delivery statuses across multiple carriers — all from your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features
* Generate and manage shipments directly from WooCommerce orders.
* Access multiple shipping carriers in MENA and Turkey.
* Automate tracking updates and delivery statuses.
* Create return shipments with one click.
* Secure API integration with OTO.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/oto-shipping-gateway directory, or install directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → OTO Shipping Gateway.
  4. Enter your OTO API credentials and start shipping!
sections.faq:
Do I need an OTO account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active OTO account with valid API credentials.

Which countries are supported?

Currently, OTO supports major carriers across MENA and Turkey.

Does the plugin support returns?

Yes. Return shipments can be created and tracked directly from WooCommerce.

  • Feature: Added environment switching (Production/Test) for API connections
  • Feature: Added installation webhook event on plugin activation
  • Feature: Added uninstallation webhook event on plugin deactivation
  • Improvement: Dynamic API base URL based on selected environment

1.0.4 – 2025-12-03

  • Feature: Added KSA specific address fields (Short Address Code, Building Number, Additional Number) to the checkout page.
  • Feature: KSA fields are only displayed when the selected country is Saudi Arabia.
  • Feature: “Short Address Code” is a required field when visible.

1.0.3 – 2025-10-19

  • Security improvements: Added nonce validation and user permission checks
  • Performance improvements: Optimized $_POST processing
  • WordPress compliance: Removed unnecessary load_plugin_textdomain() call
  • Fixed generic filter naming for better plugin compatibility
  • Enhanced input sanitization and validation

1.0.0 – 2025-02-16

  • Initial release
